name: Create: shafts, cogwheels, hand crank
context: Tier 6. Needs andesite alloy (tier 5) and planks. Recipes: 2 alloy -> 8 create:shaft; 1 shaft + 1 plank -> create:cogwheel; create:hand_crank uses planks and 1 alloy. Survival world, wherever the player is now; never assume coordinates, find things with mc_find_blocks. Never dig the block under your own feet or straight down; dig staircases or side tunnels. Avoid lava and deep water (mc_mine allowFluids only for sand/gravel at shores). Do not break blocks of player-built structures.

steps.name: be outside
steps.goal: Be outside under open sky (you need trees for wood in this plan). If you are underground, dig a staircase up: mc_dig direction=<north/south/east/west> stairs=true up=true length=32; it stops by itself on open ground. If it stops early, read why and continue in another direction.

steps.name: have 3 andesite alloy
steps.goal: You need 3 create:andesite_alloy. If you have fewer, make more: 2 andesite + 2 iron nuggets each at a crafting table (get andesite by mining it or crafting diorite + cobblestone; nuggets from an iron ingot).

steps.name: craft 8 shafts
steps.goal: At a crafting table craft create:shaft once (2 andesite alloy give 8 shafts). mc_craft handles the crafting table by itself (uses one within 6 blocks, or places yours or makes one from 4 planks, and picks it back up).

steps.name: craft 2 cogwheels
steps.goal: At a crafting table craft 2 create:cogwheel (each 1 shaft + 1 plank): mc_craft create:cogwheel times=2. Craft planks from a log first if you have none.

steps.name: craft a hand crank
steps.goal: At a crafting table craft 1 create:hand_crank with mc_craft create:hand_crank (planks + 1 andesite alloy). If mc_craft reports missing ingredients, get them and retry.
